lines.zh: 我拖着四条不协调的腿。
lines.en: I drag four legs that don't agree.

lines.zh: 我的绿色变成了病的颜色。
lines.en: My green has gone the colour of sickness.

lines.zh: 身上鼓起的包一晃一晃。
lines.en: The lumps on me sway as I move.

lines.zh: 我把脚放下，再一次抬起。
lines.en: I set one foot down, then lift it again.

lines.zh: 我走过，草一层层压下去。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass flattens layer by layer.
My face has split in two.
I set each foot without a sway.
I pass along the wall's base.

lines.zh: 我朝着有人味的地方去。
lines.en: I head toward the smell of people.
I've grown an extra pair of legs.

lines.zh: 走过的地方留下一层湿痕。
lines.en: A damp trail stays where I pass.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条断了的尾巴。
我半蹲着，背上还渗着液。
lines.en: I'm half crouched, still leaking from my back.
The lumps on me move slowly.
My eyes come in odd numbers.

lines.zh: 四周有点动静，我屏着气。
lines.en: Something's moving nearby; I hold my breath.
I have no intention of swelling.

lines.zh: 草叶晃了一下，风没那么大。
lines.en: A blade of grass stirs, though the wind is too weak for that.
My legs shake but don't weaken.
The air has a bad smell.
All I can do is wait.

lines.zh: 我认得那种绿色的衣裳。
离我三格远，别靠那么近。
lines.en: Keep three blocks between us; don't crowd so close.
I don't burst like that anymore.
I see two of you in my eyes.
That little glow on your hand is nice.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底踩在叶子上，我盯着。
lines.en: Your soles press on the leaves, and I stare at them.
One layer of earth between us.

lines.zh: 有东西从我身上流出来。
打歪了，我挪了挪脚又站正。
lines.en: That knocked me crooked; I shuffle my feet and stand straight again.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我的步子拖开了。
lines.en: That blow made my steps drag out.
Retreat? I haven't taken one step back.
There's raw meat in the air.

lines.zh: 丢在土上，别递到我嘴边。
lines.en: Drop it in the dirt; don't hold it to my mouth.

lines.zh: 脚往前挪了一步，土被踩实。
lines.en: One foot shifts forward and the soil packs down.
I open my mouth and only air comes from my throat.
Step back and I can take it.
This will last me a while.

lines.zh: 活物的味道飘过来，我偏了头。
lines.en: The smell of something living drifts over, and I tilt my head.
You hit me; I don't shift.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下一点湿的东西。

lines.en: You're not hurt, but your hand is dirty.
You crash into me and my legs don't even bend.

lines.zh: 门太窄，我们的包挤在一块。
lines.en: The door is too narrow and our lumps press together.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向倾了一下。

lines.en: The ground takes a shallow dent.

lines.zh: 被你顶了一下，我侧了半步。
lines.en: Your shove turns me half a step to the side.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，皮贴着皮。
lines.en: We press together, hide to hide.
The lumps on it move too.
We head for the village together.
It makes no sound, and neither do I.
We turn as one, both facing the same way.

lines.zh: 这块变成我的一部分了。
lines.en: This piece became part of me.

lines.zh: 脚先动，方向就那么定了。
lines.en: My feet move first, and the direction settles itself.
That little noise hasn't gone; I'm listening to it.

lines.zh: 慢慢挪就够了，它跑不掉。
lines.en: A slow shamble is enough; it can't get away.

lines.zh: 肩沉下去，我趴得贴着地。
lines.en: My shoulders drop until I'm pressed flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 你踩下的印子，我一眼就找到。
lines.en: The prints you left are found at a glance.
My neck turns and the skin drags along with it.

lines.zh: 我拿整个身子撞过去，很闷。
lines.en: I slam my whole body into it with a dull thud.
A crack opens in the wall.
My teeth are uneven, but they'll do.
My teeth hook in and shaking can't throw me off.
The lumps on me strike it.

lines.zh: 有东西从我的口里流出。
林子里多了一个绿色的影子。
lines.en: A green shape appears in the woods.

lines.zh: 树的阴影里，我一步跨出来。
lines.en: From the tree's shadow I step out with one stride.

lines.zh: 脚下的土一踩就陷下去。
lines.en: The soil gives way the moment I set foot on it.
It takes two tries to stand.
There's a bad smell in the air.

lines.zh: 我抬头，树冠上什么都没有。
lines.en: I look up and there is nothing in the canopy.

lines.zh: 这地方有我认识的味道。
火在我身上冒黑烟，味道很冲。
lines.en: Black smoke rises off me; the stink is sharp.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿折了方向。
lines.en: My legs fold the wrong way on landing.
Water enters the holes in my hide.

lines.zh: 爆响把我撕成两团，又连起来。
lines.en: The blast splits me in two, then I rejoin.
A point sticks into one of my lumps.

lines.zh: 光打在我身上，我里面在烧。
lines.en: Light strikes me; something burns inside.
Hunger pulls my hide to the bone.

lines.zh: 雷进来，我整个亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning enters; I light up for an instant.
